name: rodev-omni-enterprise
description: Full-Fidelity Roblox Script Executor, 3D Spatial Simulator, Visual UI Diffing & Remote Security Fuzzer MCP Server

scripts.build: tsc && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist/harness', { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync('src/harness/mock_roblox.lua', 'dist/harness/mock_roblox.lua'); if (fs.existsSync('src/harness/render.cjs')) fs.copyFileSync('src/harness/render.cjs', 'dist/harness/render.cjs'); fs.copyFileSync('src/harness/render.js', 'dist/harness/render.js');" && node -e "const fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');fs.mkdirSync('dist/luau/wasm',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('src/luau/wasm'))fs.copyFileSync(p.join('src/luau/wasm',f),p.join('dist/luau/wasm',f));"
scripts.test:all: npm run test:luau && tsx test/verifyEnterpriseSuite.ts && tsx test/verify3dWorldSimulation.ts && tsx test/verifyInteractiveDashboard.ts && tsx test/verifyGameSimulationSuite.ts
